collection.credit:
CREDITS: Lorsieab2 proposed making the full competition suite available in
VV1, VV2, VV3, VV4 and VV5, rewriting each to reflect its setting, and
specifically proposed VV5 Heathen/Isolan competitors and judges with political
tensions. The original VV2 Cooking Contest's premise, mechanics and text are
by Lorsieab2. The game-specific adaptations, fresh dialogue, branching,
political plots and integration notes below are written by ChatGPT.
Existing universal competitions and their previous credits remain intact.

contest.text:
The contests take place near the Tree of Life, with care not to damage its roots, waterways, nearby wildlife or ritual grounds. A critic who demands that beauty justify itself is about to meet a village that disagrees.
Two builders propose channels that carry water around, not through, the Tree's roots. One structure seems to defy the slope of the land. A careful test reveals an ingenious siphon-like arrangement or a concealed source of higher water; the builders explain it using only observable materials and simple craft. No magical violation of physics is asserted as fact.
contest.name: The Water's Unlikely Path
